fears.title: Protect Your Investment While You're Away
fears.description: Your property faces real risks when left unattended. We prevent problems before they become disasters.

items.title: Mold & Humidity Damage
items.description: Thailand's tropical climate means 80%+ humidity. Without regular airing, mold can destroy furniture, electronics, and walls within weeks.
items.solution: Weekly airing service and humidity monitoring included in all plans.

items.title: Termite Infestations
items.description: Termites cause millions in damage to Pattaya properties each year. Early detection is critical.
items.solution: Monthly termite inspections with digital photo reports.

items.title: Unauthorized Occupants
items.description: Vacant properties attract squatters. Once established, removal can take months through Thai courts.
items.solution: Regular visible presence and security coordination.

items.title: Storm & Monsoon Damage
items.description: Monsoon season brings flooding, wind damage, and debris. Quick response prevents water intrusion.
